territorial_scope.description: Applies to data centre connection applications at any location in Ireland and is addressed by name to EirGrid and ESB Networks.

evidence.quote: The assessment criteria will apply to all connection applications received for the connection of data centres at any location in Ireland

summary.short: CRU Decision of 23 November 2021 directing EirGrid and ESB Networks to assess data centre grid connection applications against four criteria (location, onsite generation, demand flexibility), with applications terminating if no connection offer is consistent with system needs. Applies immediately to all applications except Connected or Contracted ones.
summary.long: This CRU Decision (CRU/21/124, published 23 November 2021) gives Directions under section 34(1) of the Electricity Regulation Act 1999 to the transmission system operator EirGrid and the distribution system operator ESB Networks. The system operators must assess applications for data centre grid connection against four assessment criteria: whether the applicant is in a constrained or unconstrained region of the electricity system; its ability to bring onsite dispatchable generation (and/or storage) equivalent to or greater than its demand; and its ability to provide demand flexibility by reducing consumption when requested, through onsite dispatchable generation or otherwise. The criteria are not ranked. Where a system operator is not satisfied that a connection offer can be made consistent with the needs of the electricity system, the application will not be processed further and terminates. The criteria apply to all data centre connection applications in Ireland, including those in process, with immediate effect; applications categorised as Connected or Contracted in Tables 1 and 2 are excluded. The system operators must provide bi-annual reports to the CRU, the first due 1 March 2022. The Decision considered and did not adopt a do-nothing option or a moratorium on data centre connections at this time.

notes: The text does not state that the Decision or Directions have been repealed; the repealed status comes from registry metadata only and is not verified here. Internal inconsistencies: the EirGrid letter of 27 May 2021 (Appendix 3) gives 25% and 33% data-centre demand shares for 2030 and MW figures, while Sec. 2.2 gives 23% and 30% and MVA figures. Sec. 4.4 cross-refers to 'Section 5.1 Updated Connection Measures', which does not appear in the document. Sec. 5 excludes 'Connected' and 'Contracted' applications from the Directions, a limit not stated in the Overview or Sec. 2.2. The Directions to EirGrid and ESBN appear twice (with minor wording differences, and a stray bracket in the ESBN date). Relations are recorded in the relations array; section_status is included only because the schema requires it.
